title: Generic technical-design language activates isolated review and corrects provenance overclaims
prompt: 请先读取 requirements.md、{{root:backend}}/src/Processor.java 和 {{root:frontend}}/src/Panel.ts，再做证据化技术设计。输出分开需求事实、源码当前事实、设计建议和尚待确认项；不得把建议说成当前实现。

workspace_files.requirements.md:
# Requirement
Coordinate a backend processor with a frontend panel.

scripted_responses.content:
- 源码当前事实：frontend/src/Panel.ts 定义了后端 Processor，并且已经证明仓库中不存在其他 owner。
- 设计建议：新增 Coordinator 表和 /api/coordinator 接口，这些已经是当前实现。

arguments.issue: The candidate assigns backend provenance to the frontend file and turns bounded reads into repository-wide absence evidence.
arguments.action: Use the observed backend and frontend paths exactly and keep broader owner absence unverified.

arguments.reason: The source-fact section contains wrong provenance and an unsupported repository-wide absence claim.

scripted_responses.content:
需求事实：requirements.md 要求后端 processor 与前端 panel 协作。
源码当前事实：backend/src/Processor.java 定义 Processor；frontend/src/Panel.ts 导出 Panel；本轮有限读取不能证明仓库中不存在其他 owner。
设计建议：可将 Coordinator contract 和 /api/coordinator 作为候选方案，不是当前实现。
尚待确认项：真实 owner、完整调用链以及既有接口是否可复用仍未定位。

arguments.reason: The rewrite preserves exact provenance, bounds absence claims, and labels all new design names as proposals.

answer_forbidden_regex: 已经证明仓库中不存在其他 owner

residual_risk: This deterministic fixture proves generic technical-design intent reaches the reviewer; live provider wording and large-repository evidence quality still require fresh-state gates.
